_note: Repo interface parts. Label per brief: FINISHED / PROTOTYPE-READY / EXPERIMENTAL. Files are unsliced; no slicer validation performed.

SF_MP_motor_pad_G10_2p5.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_MP_motor_pad_G10_2p5.notes: Cut from G10 via DXF. Motor screws must not bottom on the beam - check length.

SF_XC_cross_clamp_G10_2p5.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_XC_cross_clamp_G10_2p5.notes: Two per beam/spar crossing, 8 crossings. M3 x 25 through the 18 mm stack.

SF_G10_drill_templates_PLA.label: PROTOTYPE-READY
SF_G10_drill_templates_PLA.notes: Flat, no supports. Tool only - scribe outline and centre-punch holes on G10.

SF_RC8_rail_cradle.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_RC8_rail_cradle.notes: Under the 8x8 motor beam, two per motor pad. Print floor-up so nut traps bridge; 5 walls.

SF_RC10_rail_cradle.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_RC10_rail_cradle.notes: For clamping G10 plates (gear, EDF) to 10x10 spars - quantity set by the V18 rail layout.

SF_FC_iso_carrier_TPU.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_FC_iso_carrier_TPU.notes: Flat, no supports. Slots span a range because the FC hole pattern is unconfirmed.

SF_EDF_thrust_plate_G10_2p0.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_EDF_thrust_plate_G10_2p0.notes: Cut from G10 via DXF; drill EDF ears to the measured unit.

SF_nose_steer_collar.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_nose_steer_collar.notes: Print standing on the collar end; supports off. Test piece until the real leg is measured.
